## Critique

The reported graded free ranks are \(1,1,2,1,1\) in degrees \(4,\ldots,8\) and zero thereafter, with no torsion. Thus the requested bounded \(c=7\) computation target is established. No all-parameter conclusion follows.
- claim-2: Correctly limits the scope of the finite computation. It does not conflict with claim-1.
